text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day, while walking near the park, I 
spotted Gold City during a photo shoot.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a short break! City-san, please 
go ahead and rest!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, I prepared a bento for you today, so 
please eat this. But let me know if you 
feel unwell at all, alright?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I got it already.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Sigh. Manager's been ridiculously 
overprotective lately. And I've ended up 
relying on her for food by default...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Having someone prepare an elaborate bento 
like this every time I work... it's kinda 
ridiculous...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Then again, making it myself is tough 
too. Even after reading cookbooks cover to 
cover, I haven't improved one bit...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're that trainer from the 
academy... Nah... was just thinking how I 
gotta handle my own stuff by myself.
choice_data_list:
It's okay to rely on others for things 
you're not good at, isn't it?

It's okay to rely on others for things 
you're not good at, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I offered some advice: while relying on 
people takes courage, there is also plenty 
you can gain precisely because you reached 
out.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, were you able to eat the bento? Is 
your stomach feeling alright?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, I'm fine. Ate the whole thing. 
Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Are you certain? You tend to endure things 
on your own... If you're worried about 
your diet, I can look into proper 
measures.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
On shooting days, I could look into 
arranging dinner as well as lunch—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's fine, you don't need to do that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah, I am concerned about meals, 
but... that's not quite what I mean.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
So you are concerned after all. Leave it 
to me and—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Like I said, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Just letting Manager fuss over me 
constantly isn't gonna solve anything. But 
on my own... I can't fix it either.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(—There are things you gain precisely 
because you rely on others. In that 
case...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Look, the truth is, I want to be able 
to make my own bentos properly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So instead of ordering meals for me, um... 
could you... teach me so I can get better 
at cooking?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, of course. Let's try cooking 
together at my place next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted Gold City 
looking around as if searching for 
someone.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Yukino! Got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*Munch munch*... So guuud~! This is 
ridiculously delicious, City-san! Even 
these wieners are cooked to absolute 
perfection!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, glad to hear.
choice_data_list:
Did you improve after learning from your 
manager?

Relying on people isn't so bad once in a 
while, right?

Relying on people isn't so bad once in a 
while, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, glad to hear.
choice_data_list:
Did you improve after learning from your 
manager?

Relying on people isn't so bad once in a 
while, right?

Relying on people isn't so bad once in a 
while, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah, well, somewhat. She's been 
teaching me quite a bit since then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, if I do say so myself, it turned 
out pretty decent.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Doing the best you can on your own is 
a given... but when you hit a wall, 
reaching out to people matters too, I 
guess.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Well, maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Gotta practice more so I can eventually 
cook all my meals properly on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously so tasty~! Is this the 
taste of a big-city bento...?! I'm blown 
away~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, calm down and just eat.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Learning from Manager and occasionally 
having Yukino taste test like this... 
might not be a bad idea.)
